questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "instalments" mean?
options: A single payment made all at once
Payments made over a period of time

They must give up all assets to the government
They can now pay small amounts in instalments
They must pay the entire tax immediately

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "upstream" mean?
options: related to earlier stages of production

questions.explain_zh: 「upstream」指的是生產的前期階段，表示原料或初步製程的成本較高。
